name: Katherine C. Scott
tagline: Top rated Family Law attorney in Tampa, Florida
about: A shareholder at Harris, Hunt, & Derr, P.A., board certified attorney Katherine C. Scott provides clients in Tampa Bay and beyond with the experienced and compassionate counsel they need when facing difficult family law situations. Focused exclusively on marital and family law for the past twelve years, she is adept at finding solutions in even the most complex cases. She helps Florida families facing disputes, decisions, and conflicts involving the following:

Known for her skill as a litigator, Ms. Scott is also a savvy negotiator and is experienced with the collaborative divorce process. Ms. Scott has served as the Chair of the Hillsborough County Bar Association Marital & Family Law Section and the Collaborative Law Section, and she is also Vice Chair of the Florida Bar's Standing Committee on Diversity & Inclusion. Ms. Scott is also a member of the Hillsborough Association of Women Lawyers and the Stann W. Givens Family Law American Inn of Court of Tampa.
Ms. Scott is committed to giving back to the community as an active member of the Junior League of Tampa and a volunteer for Lawyers for Literacy.

Ms. Scott graduated with her undergraduate degree from Emory University in 2002, and she went on to earn her law degree from Stetson University College of Law in 2007. During her law school career, she was active with moot court and interned with a U.S. magistrate judge with the U.S. District Court for the Middle District of Florida in 2006. Before joining the firm in 2010, she served as an assistant state attorney in the 12th Judicial Circuit and as an assistant public defender in the 13th Judicial Circuit.
